decisions.reason: Finned tubes are a core component of the firm's established air cooler business and survived the 2019 portfolio cleanup, so with industry growth and hiring signalling slack, results appear to meet aspirations and give no reason to search for alternatives.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's core know-how and remained after the related launches were pruned, so with available slack management is likely to keep carrying them rather than redirect the resources.
